request.query: How many annual leave days do I get per year?

response.query: How many annual leave days do I get per year?

results.text: FICTIONAL HR POLICY - RETRIEVAL TEST FIXTURE Annual leave Employees receive 20 working days of annual leave each calendar year. Requests for a planned vacation must be submitted in the HR portal at least ten working days before departure. The reporting manager approves leave based on team coverage. Up to five unused annual leave days may be carried forward into the next year and must be used by March 31. Remaining unused days expire. Annual leave is separate from casual leave and sick leave. Public holidays inside a vacation are not deducted from the annual leave balance.

FICTIONAL HR POLICY - RETRIEVAL TEST FIXTURE Casual leave Employees may take six days of casual leave per calendar year for urgent personal matters such as household appointments or family errands. No more than two consecutive casual leave days may be taken in one request. Inform the reporting manager before the workday begins whenever possible. Unused casual leave expires at year end and cannot be carried forward or paid out. Casual leave is distinct from planned annual vacations and from sick leave used for illness. The HR portal shows the remaining casual leave balance.

FICTIONAL HR POLICY - RETRIEVAL TEST FIXTURE Sick leave Employees receive ten paid sick leave days each year when illness or injury prevents work. Notify the reporting manager as soon as possible on the first day of absence. A medical certificate is required for sickness lasting more than two consecutive working days. Sick leave cannot be substituted for planned vacation. Employees returning after a serious illness may discuss temporary workplace adjustments with HR. Unused sick days expire at the end of the calendar year. Medical records must be shared privately with HR rather than posted in team channels.

FICTIONAL HR POLICY - RETRIEVAL TEST FIXTURE Bereavement leave Employees may take three paid working days of bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member. Notify the reporting manager or HR as soon as practical. HR may request supporting information sensitively after the employee returns. Bereavement leave is separate from casual leave and annual vacation. Additional time for travel or family responsibilities may be requested from the annual leave balance or as unpaid leave with approval. Immediate family includes a spouse, partner, parent, child, sibling, or an equivalent dependent relationship reviewed by HR.

FICTIONAL HR POLICY - RETRIEVAL TEST FIXTURE Public holidays The company publishes a location specific public holiday calendar at the start of each year. Employees follow the calendar assigned to their primary work location, including while temporarily working from home. Public holidays are not deducted from annual leave. Employees required to work on a listed holiday must obtain manager approval and may receive compensatory time off under the overtime policy. Optional holidays require an advance request through the HR portal. A holiday falling on a weekend does not automatically create a substitute day unless the published calendar states otherwise.
